_doc: Bestiary. All numbers deterministic: no hit chance, no damage rolls. bite_count = sprigs eaten per bite; telegraph_seconds = visible wind-up before the bite lands; itch_damage = damage taken before it shakes attackers off; seeds = shrine seeds when the corpse is carried home. sleeps_by_day: dormant until the knight or a sprig enters wake_radius. night: spawns only at night, retreats at dawn. itch_time: the shake needs both itch_damage taken AND itch_time elapsed since the last shake, so a burst cannot shake it early. back_multiplier: damage taken from behind. roams: wanders on its own around its home. prey: runs from the gnome and the squad instead of hunting them. attack: bite (mouth in front) | breath (a cone of breath_hazard out to attack_range, cone_deg wide; sprigs immune to it shrug it off) | leap (jumps to where its target stood when it crouched, crushing everything within leap_radius that is not immune to crush) | charge (rushes charge_distance in a straight line at charge_speed, trampling what is not immune to crush; dazed for daze_seconds after) | gust (blows sprigs in a cone gust_push metres back and stuns them; immune to gust stands firm) | burrow (travels underground where nothing can touch it, erupts under its target eating bite_count, then fights on the surface for surface_seconds) | none. attack_range: how close it must be to start the attack. front_multiplier: damage taken from the front (armour).

enemies.name: Bulb Grub
enemies.line: Sleeps in the open. Wakes hungry. Three sprigs a bite. Throw onto its back; pull off when it shakes.

enemies.name: Dusk Stalker
enemies.line: Comes at dusk, in twos and threes, for whatever is left in the field. Gone at dawn.

enemies.name: Field Beetle
enemies.line: Skitters about the field and bolts when you come close. Six seeds if you can catch it.

enemies.name: Cinder Hog
enemies.line: Dozes by warm ground. Swells, then breathes fire in a cone. Embers walk through it; anything else burns and runs.

enemies.name: Mire Hog
enemies.line: The bog's own hog. Its breath is the gas. Send Thorns.

enemies.name: Pounce Toad
enemies.line: Sits by the water. Crouches, then lands where you were standing. Watch its shadow. Stone and Moth are not squashed.

enemies.name: Shellback
enemies.line: Armoured in front, soft behind. Paws the ground, then rushes in a straight line. Step aside, then hit it while it is dizzy.

enemies.name: Gale Puff
enemies.line: Harmless alone. It lives beside fire and water and blows your sprigs into them. Oaks do not budge.

enemies.name: Hollow Mole
enemies.line: A moving mound. Nothing touches it underground. It comes up under you; when it surfaces, it is yours to hit.
